notes: Every surface whose native port is under the visual gate (#874, ADR-0118). A surface appears here before it is switched on, and docs/mobile/screens.json may only set "enabled": true when every state this file declares for that surface carries its evidence. Each entry names the web route, the contract (shared/visual/<surface>.json - the states, and for each state the elements and properties both clients must agree on), the test that draws the app side, and, per state, its tolerances: tolerance.length is the CSS-pixel drift allowed on a box, and tolerance.pixels is that state's recorded raster baseline - the share of the capture that differs at the best alignment, measured from the pair that passed, with the date it was recorded. Evidence lives in e2e/__visual__/<surface>/<state>/ and is recorded by `npm run visual:capture` (page) and the app's own visual test (screen).
